rows.jyutping: sai3 dou3 juk6 ngaan5 tai2 m4 dou2
rows.note: Use this when something is too small to see without a microscope or other aid.

example.english: Some dust particles are microscopic and can only be seen with a microscope.
example.traditional: 有啲塵粒細到肉眼睇唔到，要用顯微鏡先睇到。
example.jyutping: jau5 di1 can4 nap1 sai3 dou3 juk6 ngaan5 tai2 m4 dou2 jiu3 jung6 hin2 mei4 geng3 sin1 tai2 dou2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is very small.

example.english: My room is microscopic; after putting in a bed, there is no space left.
example.traditional: 我間房好細，擺張床之後就冇位喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaan1 fong4 hou2 sai3 baai2 zoeng1 cong4 zi1 hau6 zau6 mou5 wai2 laa3

rows.note: Choose this more formal term for minute physical size, especially in technical or written contexts.

example.english: This report analyzes microscopic cracks on the coating’s surface.
example.traditional: 呢份報告分析咗塗層表面嘅微細裂紋。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 fan1 sik1 zo2 tou4 cang4 biu2 min6 ge3 mei4 sai3 lit6 man4
